Firmware update

Install H9 Toolbox Firmware, or restore official v1.0.38, through the TD-H9 vendor HID recovery mode. H9 Toolbox Firmware is stock v1.0.38 with Brick Breaker (hold Back) and the service that lets you replace the startup image over Bluetooth in step 04 or on the Boot logo page. The package downloads from H9 Toolbox and is checked against its exact hash. Your radio backup stays in your browser and is never uploaded.

Before you begin

Install and restore through this page have been tested on one TD-H9 from macOS. A failed update can leave the radio unable to boot. Keep a reliable recovery method available.

Before writing, the page backs up the radio (Backup radio in step 03); keep that file. The HID backup reconstructs flash from CRC queries. On stock or H9 Toolbox firmware it takes a few seconds; on other firmware it can take about an hour. HID cannot read or write the protected first 0x5000 bytes. A Bluetooth channel .img is not a firmware recovery backup.

H9 Toolbox Firmware installs over the exact stock v1.0.38 main image, the original Brick Breaker, or an earlier H9 Toolbox Firmware install; the page refuses any other starting image. If you update older firmware to v1.0.38, recheck channels and settings afterward.

01

Connect radio

Disconnected
  1. Turn the radio off and connect a data-capable USB-C cable.
  2. Hold PTT + 2 while powering on. The screen stays blank and the top LED turns green.
  3. Click Connect radio and choose the JieLi HID device in the browser’s list.

Keep the radio connected in HID mode until you finish step 03.

02

Select firmware

✓ SelectedH9 Toolbox Firmware for v1.0.38Stock v1.0.38 with Brick Breaker and the boot logo service. Checked against its exact hash before any radio access; upgrades the original Brick Breaker directly.
✓ SelectedStock Type-C v1.0.38Reads the pinned ZIP from the third-party TDH9 mirror and verifies both the ZIP and extracted firmware hashes.

No firmware selected

You usually do not need a file here. If the radio runs stock, its backup is the restore point; if it runs H9 Toolbox Firmware or the original Brick Breaker, the restore point is official stock v1.0.38, rebuilt from verified files. Choose a file only for a radio with other firmware.

03

Write firmware

Back up the radio first: the backup downloads a recovery file of its current firmware in a few seconds (stock or H9 Toolbox firmware); keep it. Install then checks every sector on the radio (CRC only, no writes) and builds the exact plan; nothing is erased unless that check passes.

Connect the radio in step 01.

Restore writes your restore point’s firmware sectors back and checks their CRCs. Your channels and settings are never changed here; to back them up, use the Bluetooth programmer.

0%
04

Update the boot logo

Bluetooth

Needs H9 Toolbox Firmware on the radio. This opens once the page confirms it is installed; if it already is, open it now.

Show the boot logo tool

After installing H9 Toolbox Firmware, disconnect USB and power-cycle the radio so it starts normally. The logo is written over Bluetooth, sector by sector, and read back to verify. Firmware updates, including a return to stock, keep whatever logo you write here.
